scope: historical RoadmapBench verifier execution used by the released evidence

image_identity_surface.local_image_id_role: historical post-load identity; not interchangeable with the registry manifest digest
image_identity_surface.mirror_acceptance_rule: a mirror was accepted only when its manifest digest matched the official registry digest

candidate_execution.task_timeout_source: timeout_sec from the task metadata, otherwise 1800 seconds
candidate_execution.pass_rule: reward.txt parses as a number greater than or equal to 0.9999

strict_edit_transport_before_container.format: edit_json converted deterministically to a candidate patch

offline_public_replay.purpose: recompute released statistics and verify H5/E5/VCR links from saved evidence

fresh_container_rerun_boundary.status_in_public_package: documented but not bundled because image layers and protected verifier materials are excluded
